title: PoE fixtures need isolation and creepage precheck evidence
rootCause: A routed PoE-style PCB can pass DRC/ERC while still lacking explicit primary/secondary boundary, clearance, creepage, and copper keepout evidence.
fixSummary: Add an isolation/creepage calculator and safety report that estimates clearance/creepage, blocks copper crossings, and always marks final PoE compliance as engineering-review required.
